name: @elvatis_com/elvatis-mcp
description: MCP server for OpenClaw - expose smart home, memory, cron, and more to Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP client

scripts.test: npm run build && npx --no-install tsx --test tests/unit.test.ts tests/security/action-pin.test.ts tests/security/publish-guard.test.ts tests/security/version-guard.test.ts tests/security/runtime-support.test.ts tests/security/aahp-gate.test.ts tests/security/changelog-guard.test.ts tests/security/secret-scan.test.ts tests/security/forbidden-patterns.test.ts tests/security/model-injection.test.ts tests/security/dashboard-disclosure.test.ts tests/security/test-registration.test.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build

testRegistration._comment: Files under tests/ that `npm test` deliberately does not run. scripts/check-test-registration.mjs requires every entry to name a file that exists and to carry a reason, and fails when a file under tests/ appears in neither this map nor the `test` script.

excluded.tests/integration.test.ts: Live integration script, not a node:test file: it has its own assert/test helpers and is run as a plain program by `npm run test:integration`. It calls real services and needs SSH_HOST, HA_URL and a running local LLM, none of which exist on a CI runner, so it would fail there for reasons unrelated to the change under review.
